title: EmoSign: A Multimodal Dataset for Understanding Emotions in American Sign Language

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the distribution of model sentiment and emotion predictions against ground truth labels to identify systematic skews toward positive, neutral, or 'happy' labels, often due to safety alignment training.

Conducting ablation studies comparing model performance and reasoning on video-only inputs versus video with text captions, demonstrating an over-reliance on text and an inability to correctly interpret visual sign language cues.

Comparing the emotion interpretations of multimodal language models and hearing non-signers against the ground-truth annotations provided by native Deaf ASL signers to highlight systemic misinterpretations of ASL grammatical facial markers as emotional indicators.
